# comfyui-MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize-T8 v0.3.4

## 中文

- 修复长音频检查点在静音策略、预检后端、VAD 严格度、设备、精度或 Attention 后端变化后仍复用旧结果的问题；配置变化现在会安全地重新转写。
- 修复边界去重在零重叠分片中误删真实重复短句的问题；去重现在同时要求实际分片重叠和片段时间重合。
- 修复长音频语音比例未聚合、跨分片说话人映射失效、同路径模型热更新继续命中旧缓存、无重试进度按双倍计算以及并发字幕文件名冲突的问题。
- 精简 Comfy Registry 发布包，排除开发专用构建/校验脚本并消除已知扫描命中；手动发布重试现在要求明确的 Release tag 和有效密钥。
- 更新中英文 Attention 提示，使其准确描述 FlashAttention-2、SDPA、eager 的自动回退顺序。
- 增加覆盖上述边界情况的回归测试；模型权重和 OpenMOSS 审计 revision 保持不变。

## English

- Fixed stale long-audio checkpoint reuse after changing the silence policy, preflight backend, VAD aggressiveness, device, precision, or Attention backend. Configuration changes now trigger safe reprocessing.
- Fixed boundary deduplication deleting genuine repeated short phrases when chunks have no overlap. Deduplication now requires both a real chunk-overlap window and overlapping segment timestamps.
- Fixed missing long-audio speech-ratio aggregation, broken cross-chunk speaker mapping, stale same-path model caches, doubled progress totals when no retry occurs, and concurrent subtitle filename collisions.
- Minimized the Comfy Registry archive by excluding development-only build/verification tools and removing known scanner matches. Manual publication retries now require an explicit release tag and a valid token.
- Updated the Chinese and English Attention tooltips to accurately describe the FlashAttention-2, SDPA, and eager automatic fallback order.
- Added regression coverage for these edge cases; the model weights and audited OpenMOSS revision are unchanged.
